name: Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce – Create Discount Rules, Bulk Discounts, Coupons, BOGO Offers, Flash Sales
author: spluggy

sections.description:
SPLUGGY DYNAMIC PRICING IS A POWERFUL WORDPRESS PLUGIN THAT ALLOWS STORE ADMINISTRATORS TO CREATE DISCOUNT RULES, DYNAMIC PRICING RULES, BOGO OFFERS, BULK DISCOUNTS, COUPONS, FLASH SALES FOR WOOCOMMERCE PRODUCTS. WITH THIS PLUGIN, YOU CAN EASILY SET UP FLEXIBLE DISCOUNT STRATEGIES BASED ON USER ROLES AND SPECIFIC PRODUCTS

Are you still looking for Dynamic Pricing or Discount Rules plugins to boost your revenue next stage ? Wait it Over. Introducing Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce plugin, which will enhance your sales by providing features like discount rules, dynamic pricing, flash sales, BOGO deals, bulk discounts and many more. We are new so we may miss some features but we promise to add more and more in upcoming months with best level of support we can from our team

Contact Us

FEATURES OF FREE DYNAMIC AND DISCOUNT RULES PLUGIN

1) Create dynamic pricing rules
2) Flexible discount types (Percentage and Fixed Amount)
3) Import/Export rules easily
4) Easy EDIT and DELETE existing Rules
5) Flexible discounts based on User Role and Products
6) Discounts based on categories like Product, Cart, and Bulk
7) Set priority of rules
8) Set START and END date and time of rules campaign
9) Auto search products smoothly
10) Conditional based discounts
11) View all Reports at one place ( Filter, Total discounts, Average discounts, Top performing discount rule, Order item )

DISCOUNTS BASED ON CATEGORIES — REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE

Product Discount — Apply Discounts to Specific Products

This feature allows you to apply targeted discounts to individual products using WooCommerce Discount Rules as part of a flexible dynamic pricing setup. You can create percentage-based or fixed-amount discounts, schedule promotions, and combine them with bulk discount strategies.

REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE

Imagine an online electronics store powered by WooCommerce that wants to boost sales during Black Friday. To encourage more conversions, the store applies a 15% discount to the latest Bluetooth speakers while keeping other items—such as smartphones and laptops—at regular prices.

When customers visit the speaker’s product page, they immediately see the promotional pricing. At checkout, the discounted amount is applied automatically, creating a seamless shopping experience and improving the effectiveness of the store’s dynamic pricing and discount strategy.

Cart Discount — Apply Discounts Based on Cart Total

This feature allows store owners to automatically apply discounts when a customer’s cart reaches a specific total. It works seamlessly with dynamic pricing, bulk discount strategies, and WooCommerce Discount Rules, giving stores flexible control over promotional offers in their WooCommerce setup.

REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE

Imagine an online store that wants to encourage customers to increase their order value. To achieve this, the store creates a rule where customers receive a $10 discount when their cart total exceeds $100.

As shoppers add products to their cart, they see a message showing how much more they need to spend to qualify for the discount. Once the cart total goes over $100, the discount is automatically applied at checkout. This not only enhances the shopping experience but also helps increase the store’s average order value through effective dynamic pricing.

Bulk Discount — Apply Discounts based on Quantity

This feature allows store owners to offer discounts based on the quantity of items a customer purchases. It integrates smoothly with dynamic pricing, WooCommerce, and WooCommerce Discount Rules, making it easy to set up tiered or volume-based pricing that encourages larger orders.

REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE

Imagine a WooCommerce store that wants to motivate customers to buy more units of a product. To achieve this, the store sets up a bulk discount rule where buying 3 or more of the same item automatically applies a 10% discount, and purchasing 5 or more applies a 15% discount.

When customers add multiple quantities to their cart, they immediately see the price adjustment based on the discount tier they qualify for. This type of quantity-based dynamic pricing helps increase sales volume while offering shoppers a better value for buying in bulk.

HOW DYNAMIC PRICING PLUGIN WILL HELP YOUR SALES REVENUE

Boost Conversions with Spluggy Dynamic Pricing
Use powerful dynamic pricing rules to automatically adjust product prices based on quantity, user roles, or purchase history — helping you convert more visitors into paying customers

Offer Attractive Bulk Discounts
Set up bulk discount options to encourage customers to buy more items at once, increasing your average order value (AOV) and overall store revenue

Create Powerful WooCommerce Discount Rules
Easily configure WooCommerce discount rules for specific products, categories, or user groups — including percentage discounts, fixed prices, and special offers

Increase Sales Automatically
With automated dynamic pricing rules, your WooCommerce store can respond instantly to market changes, stock levels, or seasonal trends — helping you increase sales effortlessly.

Promote Limited-Time Discounts
Create urgency with time-based discounts and flash sales, encouraging quick buying decisions and reducing cart abandonment.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option, as WordPress handles the file transfer itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click Add New.

In the search field type “Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce” and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found our plugin you can view details about it such as the point release, rating, and description. Most importantly, of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our Spluggy Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce and uploading it to your webserver via your favorite FTP application.
sections.faq:

Yes, this plugin has both features listed in free version

Is it possible to add discount in percentage?

Yes, you can add discount in percentage too by mentioning particular value

Is plugin easy for use ?

Dynamic Plugin is very easy to understand even non-technical person can use
